title: CellarTracker Bottle Weekly Vintage Year Trend
dataSources: CellarTracker bottles (`cellartracker:bottle`), Vivino wines (`vivino:wine`), spirits bottles (`spirit:bottle`), and wine tasting notes (`wine:tasting`).
app: CellarTracker bottle exports, Vivino wine scans, spirits inventory logs, and tasting note journals forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=cellartracker:bottle vintage_year=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(vintage_year) as avg_duration, max(vintage_year) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst vintage year for CellarTracker bottle events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture vintage_year on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average vintage year with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It ranks whether CellarTracker bottle tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
